title: Velvety Charred Mediterranean Kabanos Skewers
description: A lazy Sunday dish featuring charred kabanos sausages, velvety eggplant, and a mediterranean twist.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 375°F.
Thread the kabanos sausages, eggplant, red onion, bell peppers, and zucchini onto metal skewers.
Brush the vegetables with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred.
Meanwhile, whisk together lemon juice, garlic, and chopped oregano in a small bowl.
Once the skewers are cooked, brush them with the lemon-herb mixture.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional oregano if desired.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Note: You can also cook the skewers in the oven at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
